rationale: All 9 prior blocking findings (CR-001..CR-009) verified resolved against current source: pagination.totalCount is now rendered above the table; actor_id is carried into PresentableActivityEvent and toPresentable() and surfaced as an Actor ID attribute row; listEvents responses are guarded by a monotonically increasing requestIdRef so a stale response no longer overwrites newer state, and a skipNextPerPageEffectRef prevents the perPage-change effect from re-issuing a conflicting page-0 load; projectName is now encodeURIComponent-wrapped in both listEvents and loadMetadata request paths; loadMetadata failures now populate a separate metadataError field and handleRetry re-issues loadMetadata when it is set; AMOUNT_KEY_HINT no longer matches 'limit'/'cost' substrings; getEventTargetLabel falls back to entity_type alone when only it is present; formatAttributeValue recurses into nested objects/arrays instead of JSON.stringify. No new blocking findings raised — this round verifies only the prior ids per the check-round contract.

standards_review.notes: all 6 commit subjects in range follow EPMCDME-14326: Capital sentence format
no code-quality standards guide in the repo and no ArtifactRef passed
no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no unsafe navigation, no secrets; attribute values render as auto-escaped React text nodes

findings.title: Total matching count is never displayed
findings.problem: Pagination preserves filters correctly, but the API's total matching count has no rendering path.
findings.impact: The required acceptance criterion "displays the total matching count from the API" has no implementing UI anywhere in the diff.
findings.recommendation: Add a total-count prop to Pagination (or render it directly beside the Table in the modal) and wire pagination.totalCount into it.

findings.title: actor_id dropped from migrated detail view
findings.problem: The new toPresentable() mapping omits actor_id entirely.
findings.impact: actor_id, a previously-visible audit identifier, is no longer shown anywhere in the UI after this migration.
findings.recommendation: Surface actor_id in the expanded row (or the Actor cell) when present.

findings.title: No sequencing guards overlapping listEvents/loadMetadata calls
findings.problem: loadEvents and the mount-time loadMetadata call fire with no AbortController or request-id tracking.
findings.impact: A slower earlier response can resolve after a newer one and overwrite the store with stale events/pagination for a filter the user has already changed away from.
findings.recommendation: Track a request id (or AbortController) per call and ignore a response that is not the latest before writing it into the store.

findings.title: Page-size change races the filter effect back to page 0
findings.problem: onPaginationChange calls setPerPage(limit) and loadEvents(page, limit) directly, but perPage is also a dependency of the filter-driven useEffect that calls loadEvents(0, perPage) whenever perPage changes.
findings.impact: Changing the page size triggers a second, conflicting load that resets back to page 0, so the user's requested page is silently discarded.
findings.recommendation: Exclude perPage-only changes from the filter effect.

findings.title: projectName not URL-encoded in the request path
findings.problem: projectName is interpolated directly into the request path with no encodeURIComponent, unlike every other v1/projects/${...} call in the codebase.
findings.impact: A project name containing '/', '?', '#', or spaces would corrupt the request path or query string.
findings.recommendation: Wrap projectName with encodeURIComponent at both call sites.

findings.title: Metadata failures cannot be recovered via Retry
findings.problem: listEvents and loadMetadata both write failures into the same shared error field; the modal's handleRetry only re-issues store.listEvents.
findings.impact: A metadata-endpoint failure surfaces the generic error/Retry UI, but clicking Retry can never re-issue loadMetadata, violating the required retry-recovers acceptance criterion.
findings.recommendation: Use separate error fields (eventsError/metadataError) and have handleRetry re-issue whichever call actually failed.

findings.title: AMOUNT_KEY_HINT regex over-matches non-monetary keys
findings.problem: AMOUNT_KEY_HINT = /(amount|budget|spend|limit|cost)/i is broad enough to match unrelated numeric keys such as retry_limit or cost_center_id.
findings.impact: A non-monetary numeric attribute whose key happens to contain one of these substrings is formatted as currency.
findings.recommendation: Tighten the hint to whole-word/suffix matches on the specific attribute keys the backend actually emits for budget events.

findings.title: getEventTargetLabel drops entity_type when entity_id is absent
findings.problem: getEventTargetLabel has no branch for an event with entity_type set but no entity_id/entity_label; it falls through to '—'.
findings.impact: An event with only entity_type set renders an em dash instead of the available type information, a regression from the previous rendering.
findings.recommendation: Add a branch returning event.entity_type before the final fallback.

findings.title: formatAttributeValue still dumps raw JSON for objects
findings.problem: formatAttributeValue falls back to JSON.stringify(value) for any object-typed attribute value.
findings.impact: A nested-object attribute on an event still renders as a raw JSON string inside the expanded row, directly contradicting the required 'never raw JSON' acceptance criterion.
findings.recommendation: Recurse into object values to render named key/value pairs instead of JSON.stringify.

finding_status.notes: ProjectActivityHistoryModal.tsx now renders '{pagination.totalCount} total event(s)' above the Table, sourced from mapActivityEventPagination(data.pagination); covered by a new modal test asserting the count 123 renders.

toPresentable() now includes actor_id: item.actor_id ?? undefined, and getEventAttributeRows appends an 'Actor ID' row when present; a new ActivityEventsPage test asserts 'a1' renders in the expanded row.

loadEvents now increments a requestIdRef and only forceRerenders if its captured id is still current, discarding stale in-flight responses; a new test resolves a slower first request after a second and asserts the stale row never appears.
onPaginationChange now sets skipNextPerPageEffectRef before setPerPage when the limit changes, and the perPage-driven useEffect consults that ref to skip its own redundant page-0 reload.
Both listEvents and loadMetadata now wrap projectName with encodeURIComponent; a new store test asserts 'proj/weird name' is requested as 'proj%2Fweird%20name' in both paths.

loadMetadata now writes failures to a new metadataError field (store.error is left untouched); handleRetry checks metadataError first and re-issues loadMetadata, else re-issues loadEvents; a new modal test asserts Retry after a metadata-only failure calls loadMetadata again, not listEvents.
AMOUNT_KEY_HINT narrowed to /(^|_)(amount|budget|spend)($|_)/i, dropping 'limit'/'cost' entirely; a new test confirms retry_limit and cost_center_id render as plain numbers, not currency.
getEventTargetLabel gained an `if (event.entity_type) return event.entity_type` branch before the '—' fallback; a new test confirms an entity_type-only event renders 'budget'.

formatAttributeValue now recurses into object/array values, rendering 'Key: value' pairs (and joining array items) instead of JSON.stringify; a new test confirms a nested object renders as readable text with no leading '{'.
